sources.snippet: Aswenna AI is an Agri-Fintech platform that operates as a commodity derivatives exchange tailored for smallholder farmers in Sri Lanka. It mitigates farm-gate price crashes by allowing farmers to lock in "floor prices" through cash-settled contracts, decoupling physical crop logistics from financial risk.
